source.author: stat
source.text: Amazonio Scythiam fervere tumultu lunatumque putes agmen descendere, ubi arma indulget pater et saevi movet ostia Belli, nec varius fremor aut studia in contraria rapti dissensus, ut plebe solet: furor omnibus idem, idem animus solare domos iuvenumque senumque praecipitare colos plenisque affrangere parvos uberibus ferroque omnes exire per annos, tunc viridi luco lucus iuga celsa Minervae propter opacat humum niger ipse, sed insuper ingens mons premit et gemina pereunt ealigne soles hic sanxere fidem, tu Martia testis Enyo atque inferna Ceres, Stygiaeque Acheronte recluso ante preces venere deae; sed fallit ubique mixta venus, venus arma tenet, venus admovet iras.
source.text_original: Amazonio Scythiam fervere tumultu / lunatumque putes agmen descendere, ubi arma / indulget pater et saevi movet ostia Belli, / nec varius fremor aut studia in contraria rapti / dissensus, ut plebe solet: furor omnibus idem, / idem animus solare domos iuvenumque senumque / praecipitare colos plenisque affrangere parvos / uberibus ferroque omnes exire per annos, / tunc viridi luco — lucus iuga celsa Minervae / propter opacat humum niger ipse, sed insuper ingens / mons premit et gemina pereunt ealigne soles — / hic sanxere fidem, tu Martia testis Enyo / atque inferna Ceres, Stygiaeque Acheronte recluso / ante preces venere deae; sed fallit ubique / mixta venus, venus arma tenet, venus admovet iras.
source.text_english: You would think Scythia was seething with Amazonian turmoil and that a crescent-shaped host was descending, where their father grants them weapons and opens the gates of savage War, and there is no varied uproar or division, no factions drawn into opposite camps, as among the common people; all are possessed by the same frenzy, the same spirit, whether of making desolate the homes of young men and old, of shattering the distaffs of those with full breasts, and of bringing all ages to their end by the sword. Then, in the green grove, the dark grove itself shades the high ridges of Minerva near by, but above it a huge mountain presses close, and the twin suns perish there in a gloomy valley. Here the gods have sealed the pledge; you too, Enyo of Mars, and Ceres of the underworld, and the Stygian goddesses, with Acheron laid open, came before the prayers. But everywhere Venus is mingled in deception; Venus holds the arms, Venus brings on the rage.

reuse.text: fervere cuncta virum coetu, simul undique cernit delatum nemus et docta resonare bipenni litora; iam pinus gracili dissolvere lamna Thespiaden iungique latus lentoque sequaces molliri videt igne trabes, remisque paratis Pallada velifero quaerentem bracchia malo.
reuse.text_original: fervere cuncta virum coetu, simul undique cernit / delatum nemus et docta resonare bipenni / litora; iam pinus gracili dissolvere lamna / Thespiaden iungique latus lentoque sequaces / molliri videt igne trabes, remisque paratis / Pallada velifero quaerentem bracchia malo.
reuse.text_english: he sees all things seething with a company of men, and at the same time the grove brought in from every side and the shores echoing with the skilled double axe; already the pine is being split into thin planks, the Thespian joined, and the sides fitted together, and the following timbers softened by the slow fire, and Pallas, with the oars prepared, seeking the arms on the sail-bearing mast.
